title: [v3 bug mac] CMD-A closes dialogs
body:
### Description

When you open a file dialog and do cmd+a the app quits. This happens when a go function is called from the frontend



### To Reproduce


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aa6f95ba-3942-41d8-b5a6-444abd8dc7de



### Expected behaviour

The app should not crash and all the items should be selected.

_No response_

### Attempted Fixes
